findings.explanation: All 83 settled card batches from 2026-08-01 through 2026-10-22 (20 representative bank_ids shown; full count 83) deposited short of the expected net, total shortfall 122,053c on gross sales of 41,262,193c. Every one of the 83 shortfalls is explained exactly by an effective fee of 2.9% of gross + 15c/transaction instead of the contracted 2.6% + 15c (e.g. 2026-08-01: deposit 547,122c implies fee 16,973c = 0.029x564,095 + 41x15c, vs expected fee 15,281c; last row 2026-10-22: implied fee 12,521c = 0.029x417,820 + 27x15c). The 278 batches settled before 2026-08-01 all matched the 2.6%+15c expectation within 10c, so the rate step-change took effect on the 2026-08-01 batch and has persisted every day since, including the 2026-10-23 batch pending settlement (not_yet_due, not counted as an error). No duplicate or missing settlements: 362 batches map 1:1 to 362 TABLETAP PAYMENTS DEP deposits, unmatched_deposits = 0. Current monthly excess is 46,266c (sum of the latest 30 settled days 2026-09-23..2026-10-22), about 30c per $100 of card sales.

Until corrected, budget card fees at 2.9% + 15c (~$463/month excess) in the forecast, and consider switching processors if the contractual rate is not honored.

limitations: Unverified: snapshot completeness is assumed, not checked.
Agreements, supplier terms, leases, loans and other reference data have no version history; their validity at the cutoff is assumed.

Payment status is 'unknown' unless a payment record dated on or before the cutoff exists (payroll runs, owner draws, sales-tax paid dates, recorded invoice payments, chargeback debits). Autopay assumptions and current open AP are not used. 'unknown' is not evidence of non-payment.
Nessie bills (pending and recurring) are current state with no dated snapshot, so bill history is unavailable.
Open AP and deposits in transit are snapshot-only state and are omitted.
Dispute outcomes and actual payment dates after the cutoff are hidden. Contractual due dates are kept; expected settlement and payout dates are estimates from the agreements, not bank facts.
Balances are opening balances plus completed bank activity; pending rows and rows before an account's opening date are excluded.
Platform sales are cut off at the cutoff before weekly aggregation; weeks with complete_week=false are partial.
Cash counted but not yet deposited at the cutoff is snapshot-only state and is omitted.

Fee per batch is estimated by the books from batch totals at 2.6%+15c while TableTap rounds per transaction, so a few cents of difference per batch is expected; the observed shortfalls are 800-2,988c per batch, far beyond rounding.
Bank memos do not show why the effective rate is 2.9% + 15c (rate increase, add-on fee, or interchange pass-through); the processor statement is needed to confirm the mechanism.
Batch 2026-10-23 settlement (expected 2026-10-26) is not due until after the cutoff and is excluded from the error count; if it settles at 2.9%+15c the creep continues.
TableTap POS subscription autopay ($165/month) and hardware protection are outside this batch's settlement reconciliation scope; they were spot-checked and cleared.
Two chargebacks (38,315c total) were verified as documented lost disputes; no recovery claims were assessed in this batch.
Cash counted but not yet deposited at the 2026-10-23 cutoff is snapshot-only state and is omitted.
Snapshot completeness is assumed, not checked.
Till over/short (POS cash vs counted cash) is treated as operating variance, not a bank error.
Small deposit-vs-slip differences were judged immaterial against a $10 threshold; a $200 single-day short is treated as material.
The missing $200 on 2026-02-10 was not found as a later offsetting deposit within the window; its disposition (loss, theft, or deposit error) is outside bank evidence.
Snapshot completeness assumed; unverified.
Expected payouts are computed from books POS subtotals at the contractual 15%; if POS subtotals misstate platform-reported subtotals, correction amounts shift accordingly.
Expected payout dates are estimates from the RapidPlate agreement; observed deposits fell on the expected Tuesdays (2026-06-02, 2026-06-09, 2026-06-16).
Recovery of the 53240c overcharge depends on RapidPlate issuing credits; outcome after the cutoff is not visible in the snapshot.
Final week 2026-10-19 is partial (complete_week=false) and its payouts (expected 2026-10-27, after cutoff) are excluded from exceptions, not errors.
